What is the average track length per media type, in minutes?

tool_calls.name: run_sql
tool_calls.arguments:
{"sql":"SELECT mt.MediaTypeId, mt.Name AS MediaType, ROUND(AVG(t.Milliseconds)/60000.0, 2) AS AvgMinutes, ROUND(AVG(t.Milliseconds), 2) AS AvgMilliseconds, COUNT(*) AS TrackCount
FROM Track t
JOIN MediaType mt ON t.MediaTypeId = mt.MediaTypeId
GROUP BY mt.MediaTypeId, mt.Name
ORDER BY AvgMilliseconds DESC;"}
